systems.owner: Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education; the 2025 revision supported by IIEP-UNESCO and funded by the Global Partnership for Education
systems.tiers: a yearly questionnaire answered by each school on enrolment, infrastructure and teacher deployment, with climate and disaster-risk questions added in 2025

note: The document describes only the annual school census, which gives no fact; the revised form asks each school whether it has digitalised its school records, and the document gives no answers to that question.
